description: Derive the workspace directory key from an issue identifier by replacing every byte of its UTF-8 encoding not in [A-Za-z0-9._-] with '_' (Section 9.5, Invariant 3; decision 0047). A non-ASCII code point yields one '_' per UTF-8 byte; the identifier is not normalized first. The most important portability invariant.

vectors.description: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen are all allowed and pass through unchanged.
The three allowed punctuation characters survive.
Path separators and spaces are not allowed and each becomes a single underscore.
Disallowed ASCII punctuation is replaced character-for-character.
A precomposed accented letter (U+00E9, UTF-8 C3 A9) is two disallowed bytes and yields two underscores.

The base letter is kept; the combining accent (U+0301, UTF-8 CC 81) is two disallowed bytes. Byte-wise sanitization is intentionally normalization-sensitive (decision 0047), so this differs from the precomposed form.
A run of disallowed characters yields one underscore each; length is preserved.
